newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex Manila unit cuts petroleum prices.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Manila unit cuts petroleum prices.

text.p: Caltex (Philippines) Inc said on Friday it will reduce prices of its petroleum products by an average of one centavo per litre.

In a statement, Caltex said jet fuel price will be reduced the most by 19.23 centavos per litre, followed by diesel by 16.12 centavos, fuel oil by 11.22 centavos, kerosene by 8.65 centavos, and regular gasoline by 2.80 centavos per litre.

The company, however, will raise pump price of premium gasoline by 41.31 centavos a litre and unleaded gasoline by 0.59 centavos. Liquefied petroleum gasoline will be increased by 62.36 centavos per litre.
The price adjustments will take effect on Saturday, when full deregulation of the oil industry comes into effect.
Other oil refiners Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp and Petron Corp have earlier announced a reduction in prices of most of their products.
Caltex Philippines is a unit of Caltex Petroleum Corp which is a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp .
